title: Contact & Support
seoDescription: Get in touch with Golden Bay Holiday Homes for guest support, lockbox help, Wi‑Fi, linen, and booking questions.
intro: We're locals — and we're here to help. Reach us by phone or email for anything from lockbox codes to local recommendations.
hours: We aim to respond within a few hours during the day. For urgent check-in issues, call us.

faqs.q: Where do I find the lockbox code?
faqs.a: Lockbox or access instructions are sent in your booking confirmation and pre-arrival message. If you can't find them, call or text us.
Try restarting the modem if accessible. Network names and passwords are in the property guide. Contact us if you're still stuck — we'll help remotely or send someone.
Hotel-quality linen and towels are provided. Extra sets may be available on request for longer stays.

faqs.q: How do I change or cancel my booking?
faqs.a: See our Cancellation Policy. Contact us as soon as possible and we'll guide you through the next steps for direct bookings.
